cases.title: Resource admission limits and desktop responsiveness during mission/media workloads
cases.notes: Separately completed shared-host 16 GiB full45 also FAILED: 20 media cycles passed, but seven bridge 503 responses, one relay readiness 503, one 120-second container timeout and one 15-second Grok status timeout were recorded. Structured classifier: 2404 records, zero parse errors, 50 overlapping-category hard-fault records. Exact QEMU peaked at 4278 MiB swapped. Midpoint local AI returned READY in 5.414 seconds after administrative unlock, so uninterrupted UI responsiveness is not established. Independent cleanup and clean shutdown confirmed; complete raw evidence and exact scan-findings disposition retained. No sole-cause or remediation claim.
